J1_attention_hypothesis_current_world_si.reason: Attention allocates candidate focus, Hypothesis forms candidate explanations, Current World composes read-only global snapshot; three parts are one state-formation pipeline and should be one complete module to avoid contract drift across micro-stages.

boundary: Hypothesis: candidate explanation space construction with conflict and unknown preservation
Causal Governance: causal-hypothesis qualification and evidence-structured downstream handoff for decision chain
J2_hypothesis_vs_causal_governance_bound.anti_duplication_rule: Hypothesis module must not output causal truth, decision, or action; Causal remains owner of causal hypothesis state and causal handoff semantics.

boundary: Current World: read-only multi-owner state composition snapshot
Field State Reducer: field-specific reduction/policy candidate production
J3_current_world_vs_field_state_reducer_.anti_duplication_rule: Current World cannot become second field owner or second world state runtime; it references field outputs and preserves provenance only.

J4_dynamic_function_start_readiness.reason: Dynamic function/state-vector requires stable, high-quality input states (attention/hypothesis/current-world) that are not yet module-closed in controlled implementation form.

J5_learning_dependency_on_memory_experie.reason: Learning architecture exists but memory/experience has not completed formal controlled integration as a full module, so direct implementation now risks parallel lifecycle/owner definitions.

risk_matrix.major_risk: state-composer overreach into decision or field mutation
risk_matrix.mitigation: enforce read-only composition + no decision/no mutation guards

risk_matrix.major_risk: parameter/state-vector authority leakage into owner layers
risk_matrix.mitigation: strict governance boundaries and deferred start until state inputs close
